Active listening keeps the microphone on and writes what is said near this device to your diary, including what other people say. Let them know first.

Transcription happens on the server and spends your plan's credits. The audio is not kept.

Turn it on?

vault.title: Vault
vault.subtitle: What Killio hears and remembers for you: your diary, active listening and the assistant's memory.

diary.empty: Nothing in the diary for this day
diary.emptyHint: The diary writes itself while active listening is on.

listening.what: With active listening the microphone stays on and what is said nearby is written to your diary, phrase by phrase.
listening.needsApp: Active listening works inside Killio App.
listening.limits: Transcribing on the server spends the plan's credits. Without a connection phrases are not saved. On desktop, closing the window while listening keeps Killio App in the system tray.
listening.wakeHint: While listening is on, a phrase that starts by calling Killio ("Hey Killio, create a card for…") is handed to the assistant as an order. Anyone nearby can say it.
listening.onDeviceHint: The audio never leaves the device and no credits are spent, but it is less accurate than the server (in tests, about one word in sixteen wrong in English and one in seven in Spanish) and takes a few seconds per phrase; longer on a phone. The first time it downloads a model of about 65 MB. Saving to the diary still needs a connection.

models.intro: The speech models Vault uses and where they run. Telling who is speaking happens on your device; transcription, on the server or, if you choose, on your device too.
models.notYet: Not available in Killio App yet
models.appNote: On-device models will only exist inside Killio App.

speakers.title: Tell who is speaking
speakers.hint: Each diary phrase says who said it: "Person 1", "Person 2"… until you name them. It is worked out on this device: neither the audio nor the voice prints leave it. The first time it downloads a model of about 40 MB. Let the people around you know: a voice print identifies a person.
speakers.none: No voice heard yet. Phrases shorter than 2 seconds are not labelled.
speakers.nameTaken: Another voice already has that name.
speakers.clear: Delete every voice print on this device
speakers.clearConfirm: Every voice print kept on this device will be deleted. Labels already written to the diary do not change. Continue?
speakers.failed: The last voice could not be recognised:
